fair_value.method: Sum of the parts per share (3.54B diluted shares): core auto+energy on ~$2.40 2027E non-GAAP EPS x 45 = ~$108 (energy growing 40%/yr in deployments carries the premium); FSD/robotaxi option ~$150 (roughly $530B, i.e. ~25% odds of a ~$2T autonomy business discounted); Optimus/AI/Terafab option ~$60; net cash ~$12. Total ~$330, about 11% below the price; the stock trades on the optionality more than current earnings (~$1.77 2026E EPS, >200x trailing).

bear.story: Core auto margins stay near 16% with GAAP operating margin in low single digits, >$25B/yr capex drives persistently negative FCF and new debt, NHTSA slows Cybercab/driverless scaling, Optimus ramp stays 'flat and long'; multiple compresses toward the July low and below (~$240).

base.story: Deliveries roughly flat to up modestly in 2027, energy keeps growing, robotaxi expands to more metros/states at double-digit weekly growth but remains immaterial to revenue; EPS recovers to ~$2.3-2.6; stock stays range-bound ($300-450) on narrative, ends near today's level.

bull.story: Cybercab clears NHTSA, unsupervised robotaxi scales to many states with visible per-mile economics, AI5 and Optimus production show real volume, possible SpaceX tie-up re-rates Musk ecosystem; stock retakes and exceeds the $499 high.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$250 (about 16% under the July-2026 low of $297-304 and ~33% below today) the market would likely be pricing a failure of the autonomy thesis (e.g., NHTSA forcing Cybercab recall/halt, a serious robotaxi accident, or robotaxi growth stalling) and/or a core-business earnings collapse with FCF deeply negative and debt-funded capex, not ordinary 46%-vol noise.

catalysts.event: Q3 2026 deliveries (consensus ~456-470k vs ~497k in Q3 2025; Goldman at 435k)
Q3 2026 earnings: margins, capex (> $25B FY26), FCF, debt facilities, robotaxi metrics
NHTSA Cybercab FMVSS self-certification inquiry outcome
Robotaxi expansion to new metros/states; Tesla Semi and Megapack 3 production ramps; Terafab announcement
Q4 2026 deliveries and FY2027 guidance/capex outlook
Annual shareholder meeting; Optimus Giga Texas factory start (~summer 2027); AI5 volume

key_uncertainties: Pace and regulatory path of unsupervised robotaxi / Cybercab (NHTSA probe on no-controls vehicle)
Whether core auto margins recover from 16.3% ex-credits and GAAP operating margin of 1.4%
Return on >$25B/yr capex and financing (up to $30B debt) vs negative FCF
Optimus production timing and real commercial utility
Tesla-SpaceX merger or other Musk-ecosystem transactions and terms
Post-US-tax-credit demand and competition, especially China/Europe
reasoning: Evidence: Q2 2026 revenue $28.2B (+26%) with record 480k deliveries, but non-GAAP EPS $0.33 (miss vs $0.53), GAAP operating margin 1.4%, capex $5.8B (+142%), FCF -$1.1B, cash $43.5B, FY26 capex >$25B and up to $30B of debt facilities. Stock fell ~14% post-earnings to a July low near $304, rallied ~18% in August on delivery strength, robotaxi expansion (7 metros, unsupervised in Austin/Florida, >1M unsupervised miles) and the Tesla/SpaceX Terafab chip plant, then dipped ~6% on the underwhelming Sept 3 Cybercab launch and NHTSA certification probe. Q3 deliveries (Oct 2) are expected to fall YoY vs the tax-credit-pulled-forward Q3 2025. Consensus 2026 EPS $1.77; analyst targets average ~$397 (median ~$407, range $125-600), rating split roughly half Buy/half Hold. Valuation: earnings alone support only ~$100/share; my sum of parts puts fair value ~$330, meaning ~70% of value is optionality, which is what makes the distribution wide. Judgment: fundamentals argue slightly below spot, analyst targets and momentum/narrative (robotaxi scaling, Optimus, possible SpaceX deal) slightly above, so I center the median at ~spot ($372-375) with a mild right skew in dollar terms from lognormal shape. Distribution built as a mixture of lognormals (bear 25% median $280 sigma 0.40; base 50% median $375 sigma 0.33; bull 25% median $500 sigma 0.38), implying an effective ~45-50% vol consistent with the 46% realized vol and TSLA's history of 50-70% annual moves; left tail lightly fattened for binary regulatory/accident risk. No option data was consulted.
